<DOCSTRING>
Logs whether a user is an adult or a minor.

Determines if the given user is an adult and logs the appropriate message. This function is useful for applications that need to differentiate between adult and minor users for access control or other purposes.

@param {javascript.user.User} user - The user object to check.
@returns {void} - This function does not return a value.
</DOCSTRING>
